title: Whispers from the Liminal — ep. 12 · pour 1

nodes.text: WHISPERS FROM THE LIMINAL · ep. 12 · pour 1
A love poem, mostly couplets. Read it slow.
Then read it again and decide who it’s dangerous to.

I am in love.
It makes the world tremble.
It sets my heart on fire and by extension the world must burn.

When I love, lives are shattered.
I hope the hurt will do some good.

I sit here wondering how to feel
when I am alone often by choice.

compromise a rarity,
when I what I do is bleed word.

always & often hidden
not so much wanted as needed.

perpetual unyield locked away-
sure, but holding the key.

broken hearted dreamer
playful erstwhile schemer.

simple ton water beat
agate rock about eight stone.

she holds herself up against still form-
deep breath caught held tremble
everything so wrong it must be right.

words a gift to unravel
heart spilled out and stared at

a brain with fangs devouring
the parts she'd like kept secret.

whispers near her ear
promises of a shared destiny-
minus a wish or two

surprises best discovered
happening right this minute.

where & when exactly
was this
hidden.
Where and when, exactly. Good question. Goodnight.
